title: Yellow Coconut Spanish Chicken Cocido Madrileno
description: A cultured and springy Spanish dish featuring rice wine and coconut cream, this recipe is a quick fix for a delicious meal. It is diabetic friendly and made in a traditional copper pot.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large copper pot over medium high heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the chicken breast and cook until it is browned on all sides and cooked through.
Add the rice wine, coconut cream, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook until the sauce has thickened and the flavors have melded together.
Serve the chicken and sauce hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
Let the dish rest for 10 minutes before serving to allow the flavors to meld together.
Serve with crusty bread or over rice or noodles.
Garnish with lemon wedges and chopped fresh herbs if desired.
